# JavaScript Game Maker Cheat Sheet {#sec-cheat-sheet}

## Plan before choosing code

**Build the scene structure → Style the scene → Program game behavior.** Choose the job first, then the tool. JavaScript can help with all three jobs in canvas and 3D games.

| Step | Prepare or change | Quick check |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Build the scene structure | HTML groups and controls; canvas or 3D objects; level layout and game data. | Are the needed parts present and arranged sensibly? |
| Style the scene | CSS; canvas drawing; sprites; materials, lights, and readable feedback. | Can a player recognize the goal, controls, and important objects? |
| Program game behavior | Input, state, decisions, movement, collisions, scoring, and restart. | Does one action produce the predicted result? |

Keep these patterns nearby while you build. Examples with `...` are sketches, not finished code.

| Tool | `Example` | Use it when... |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Variable | `let score = 0;` | Stores a value that can change. |
| Constant | `const speed = 4;` | Names a value whose binding you do not plan to reassign. |
| Decision | `if (score >= 10) { ... }` | Runs code only when a condition is true. |
| Function | `function jump() { ... }` | Names a reusable action. |
| Random | `Math.floor(Math.random() * 10)` | Makes an integer from 0 to 9. |
| Array | `const enemies = [];` | Stores a collection. |
| Loop | `for (const enemy of enemies) { ... }` | Processes items one at a time. |
| Timer | `setInterval(move, 1000);` | Repeats on a time interval. |
| Animation | `requestAnimationFrame(loop);` | Runs the next animation frame. |
| Canvas | `ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, h);` | Draws a rectangle. |
